title: RegistrationLinkApprovals
description: D-180 ruling 1 (T-052). A human-created, tenant-scoped, expiring approval that lets the read-only registration-link resolver and Zoom confirmation proof accept one exact link/scope/policy binding. Created only through POST /registration-approvals (scope registration:approve, human reviewer identity). expiresAt is at most approvedAt + 30 days; that cross-field bound is runtime-enforced. The raw link is never stored, only its sha256.

linkHash.description: sha256 of the canonical (WHATWG-serialized) registration URL.

policyHash.description: Hash of the current registration policy revision.

bindingHash.description: Zoom proof only: the bound attempt hash.

hostScopeHash.description: Zoom proof only: hash of the allowed confirmation hosts.

approvedBy.description: Human reviewer subject from server-owned review authority; never a bot or service key.
